svg.aria-label: Map of St Elzéar's places and churches, numbered: 1 Ansouis, his castle, with the church of Saint-Martin and the reliquary busts of Elzéar and Delphine; 2 Cabrières-d'Aigues and the castle of Robians, his birthplace, with the chapel of Notre-Dame-de-Toutes-Fleurs and Saint-Elzéar; 3 Apt, the Cathedral of Sainte-Anne, where his relics are kept, and the Franciscan church where he was buried; 4 Puimichel, Delphine's castle, with the chapel of Saint-Elzéar; 5 Montfuron, the chapel of Saint-Elzéar; 6 Marseille, the Abbey of Saint-Victor, where he was schooled by his uncle; 7 Avignon, the Petit Palais museum with carvings from his tomb and the collegiate church of Saint-Didier with a reliquary of Elzéar and Delphine; 8 Sabran, the ruined castle of his family. Inset of the Kingdom of Naples: 9 Naples, the Basilica of Santa Chiara with the tombs of King Robert and Duke Charles of Calabria; 10 Ariano Irpino, his county. Inset of the El Paso Mission Trail on the Rio Grande: 11 the San Elizario Presidio Chapel, named for him; 12 the Socorro Mission; 13 the Ysleta Mission.
